name: qt
command: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src:ro" aerolith-dev:latest bash -c 'cd /src && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen QT_FORCE_STDERR_LOGGING=1 qml6 tests/js/run-qt.qml'

name: full-saturated
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/saturated.json AUDIO=1 MEDIA=1 MPV_AO=pipewire ROUTINES=tests/fixtures/routines.json tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/full.sh build/A03/full-saturated

name: full-insane
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/insane.json AUDIO=1 MEDIA=1 MPV_AO=pipewire ROUTINES=tests/fixtures/routines.json tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/full.sh build/A03/full-insane

name: deck-insane
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/insane.json AUDIO=1 HYPR_MOCK_ARGS="--mode 2560x1440 --scale 1.5 --transform 1" tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/deck.sh build/A03/deck-insane

name: ai-saturated
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/saturated.json AI=1 AUDIO=1 AI_PROVIDER=claude tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/ai.sh build/A03/ai-saturated

name: ai-insane
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/insane.json AI=1 AUDIO=1 AI_PROVIDER=claude tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/ai.sh build/A03/ai-insane

name: installed-saturated
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/saturated.json AUDIO=1 INSTALL="--ai claude --startup hyprland" tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/installed.sh build/A03/installed-saturated

name: installed-insane
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/insane.json AUDIO=1 INSTALL="--ai claude --startup hyprland" tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/installed.sh build/A03/installed-insane

name: ai-codex-saturated
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/saturated.json AI=1 AUDIO=1 AI_PROVIDER=codex tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/ai.sh build/A03/ai-codex-saturated

name: ai-codex-insane
command: CONFIG=docs/verification/A03/insane.json AI=1 AUDIO=1 AI_PROVIDER=codex tools/headless/run.sh tests/scenarios/ai.sh build/A03/ai-codex-insane
